mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_console_resource WHERE permission_id=#{permissionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_gateway_route WHERE permission_id=#{permissionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_role_permission WHERE permission_id=#{permissionId} AND status='ACTIVE'

SELECT resource_id resourceId,resource_code resourceCode,display_name displayName,channel,resource_type resourceType,status FROM t_console_resource WHERE permission_id=#{permissionId} ORDER BY resource_code,resource_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.route_code routeCode,r.channel,r.http_method httpMethod,r.external_path_template externalPathTemplate, t.target_service_code targetServiceCode,r.status FROM t_gateway_route r JOIN t_gateway_target t ON t.target_id=r.target_id WHERE r.permission_id=#{permissionId} ORDER BY r.route_code,r.route_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.role_id roleId,r.role_code roleCode,r.role_name roleName,r.status roleStatus,rp.status grantStatus,r.scope_key scopeKey FROM t_role_permission rp JOIN t_role r ON r.role_id=rp.role_id WHERE rp.permission_id=#{permissionId} AND rp.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.role_code,r.role_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT resource_id FROM t_console_resource WHERE permission_id=#{permissionId} AND channel='OPERATIONS' ORDER BY resource_id FOR SHARE
SELECT r.route_id FROM t_gateway_route r JOIN t_gateway_target t ON t.target_id=r.target_id WHERE r.permission_id=#{permissionId} AND r.channel='OPERATIONS' ORDER BY r.route_id FOR SHARE

SELECT FROM t_permission p WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_console_resource cr WHERE cr.permission_id=p.permission_id AND cr.channel='OPERATIONS' AND cr.status='ACTIVE') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_gateway_route gr JOIN t_gateway_target gt ON gt.target_id=gr.target_id AND gt.channel=gr.channel WHERE gr.permission_id=p.permission_id AND gr.channel='OPERATIONS' AND gr.authorization_mode='HUMAN_PERMISSION' AND gr.status='ACTIVE' AND gt.status='ACTIVE')) AND p.status='ACTIVE'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_tenant_member_role g JOIN t_role r ON r.role_id=g.role_id AND r.scope_key=g.role_scope_key JOIN t_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.role_id AND rp.status='ACTIVE' WHERE g.tenant_member_id=#{memberId} AND rp.permission_id=p.permission_id AND )
ORDER BY p.permission_id
